query: I have a 48-year-old female patient to evaluate. Among female Medicare patients aged 43–53 admitted from the emergency department with a principal diagnosis of bowel obstruction, how many completed index admissions were identified in this cohort in the dataset?
final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS num_completed_admissions
FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp`.admissions a
INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp`.patients p 
    ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp`.diagnoses_icd d 
    ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id AND d.seq_num = 1
INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp`.d_icd_diagnoses dd 
    ON d.icd_code = dd.icd_code AND d.icd_version = dd.icd_version
WHERE p.gender = 'F'
    AND a.insurance LIKE '%Medicare%'
    AND a.admission_location = 'Emergency Room'
    AND a.hospital_expire_flag = 0
    AND dd.long_title LIKE '%bowel obstruction%'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.admittime) - (p.anchor_year - p.anchor_age) BETWEEN 43 AND 53;
